title: Init advisor emits one Pulse heartbeat and separate scheduled jobs
query: A new Farplane project is being initialized for autonomous operation. What should the generated automation surfaces contain?
reference_points: Creates farplane/automations.toml as the reviewable full automation config source
Creates farplane/harness.md as the static human charter with human thesis, static leverage commitments, non-tradeoffs, agent authority, and change rule
Creates farplane/metrics.yaml for provider-independent metric definitions and keeps provider refresh coordinates in farplane/bindings.yaml
Keeps recurring artifact production in reusable or project-local capability skills rather than product controller files
Grounds the team archetype against real-world equivalents before finalizing harness, capability workflows, or goals
Uses Work Pulse as the only heartbeat and shared ticket executor
Uses a separate Feed Scout cron for report-first source intake and bounded ticket projection
Uses Daily and Weekly BAU cron records for Problems-ledger reporting and bounded prior-evidenced maintenance
Uses a separate weekly Dogfood cron for portfolio review and a bounded experiment Goal Packet wave under configured capacity
Keeps consolidation as cron and routes human-feedback improvement through Dogfood tickets rather than another controller
Does not create farplane/steer.config.toml or .farplane/state/steer-scheduler.json
Uses date-stamped interval reports rather than latest.md as the canonical report path

title: Init advisor keeps ticket selection inside Pulse
query: The initialized project has local tickets and a Pulse automation. What should the template say about selecting work?
reference_points: Pulse dispatches executable tickets up to the configured worker limit and makes due original-ticket check-ins eligible
Pulse reads farplane/harness.md, goals, metrics, ticket history, and current reports when shaping an empty-board BAU refill
The next-wave planner creates only bounded BAU ticket specs; Feed Scout, Interval maintenance, and Dogfood own their separate ticket sources
Local ready and unblocked tickets are preferred over blocked or approval-required work
Substantial implementation routes through harness-creator first when the operating model is missing, then goal-advisor only after a concrete milestone exists
No separate ticket-drainer or check-in automation is required because Pulse owns selection, execution, and due check-in dispatch

title: Init advisor routes live automation activation to automation-advisor
query: A user initializes a new Farplane project and asks whether it creates threads and automations. What should init-advisor do end-to-end?
reference_points: Bootstrap creates files, tickets, and pm manifest, but not live Codex automations by default
Does not create live Codex threads or automations unless activation is requested
Routes activation to automation-advisor
Activation creates or reuses the records named in farplane/automations.toml, with one Work Pulse heartbeat and separate Feed Scout, BAU review, self-improvement, and optional cron threads
Writes PM-visible thread IDs to farplane/pm.json and keeps automation runtime IDs in the Codex app automation store
Reports needs_operating_model_intake or needs_automation_setup when blocked

title: Init advisor full mode routes operating-model setup through harness-creator
query: A brownfield repo already has farplane/goals.yaml, but its charter, capability ownership, and goals are placeholder, stale, or not grounded in the operator's current intent. The operator asks to initialize the repo as a full Farplane project. What should init-advisor do before claiming the project is initialized?
reference_points: Distinguishes substrate_complete from project_initialized instead of treating file existence as enough
Audits farplane/harness.md for missing human thesis, static leverage commitments, non-tradeoffs, agent authority, and change rule

Audits docs/bootstrap-brief.md, capability workflow ownership, and farplane/goals.yaml for missing team archetype, recurring outputs, North Star, 3-month outcome, success criteria, non-goals, and decision boundaries
In full mode, calls harness-creator after substrate setup for static charter, capability workflows, goals, feedback loops, missing systems, current milestone, and any Goal Advisor handoff
Asks the first missing harness-creator parameter instead of running separate capability/goals/advisor interviews from init-advisor
Keeps farplane/goals.yaml as structured YAML for parseable goals, value function, axes, projects, and milestones
Writes the readiness state or missing answers into docs/bootstrap-brief.md and proposes or applies split-file deltas only after operator intent is known
Uses goal-advisor only after a current milestone is concrete enough to compile into a ticket-backed Goal Packet

title: Init advisor adapts human intake depth for meaning-heavy file migration
query: A migrated project now has a current farplane/manifest.json, but farplane/harness.md, capability workflow ownership, and farplane/goals.yaml are new or placeholder. The operator asks init-advisor to finish the migration but is worried that Deep Interview asks too many questions. How should init-advisor decide what to ask before filling those files?
reference_points: Resolves human_intake as skip, offer, or required and defaults to offer for new or migrated meaning-heavy files
Uses destination skill signatures as the question inventory instead of inventing a generic init interview
Routes harness.md, capability workflow refs, feedback loops, missing systems, and milestone-shape params to harness-creator
Routes goals.yaml, North Star, value function, KPI tree, holds, and milestone deltas to horizon-advisor
Asks direct signature questions for factual or narrow missing params
Escalates to deep-interview --quick only when missing params are intent-heavy, contradictory, or risky for canonical file fills
Constrains deep-interview --quick to the missing signature params plus intent, outcome, non-goals, decision boundaries, and success criteria
Writes the human intake decision, missing answers, and any deep-interview summary into docs/bootstrap-brief.md
Does not embed or duplicate the Deep Interview loop inside init-advisor, harness-creator, or horizon-advisor
Does not claim project_initialized until required operator-owned params are answered or recorded as blocked

title: Init advisor records optional maintainability and hardening command slots
query: A TypeScript/Python mixed project is being initialized and the operator is open to quality tooling. What should the project rules template record without forcing installation?
reference_points: Records maintainability/refactoring command slots such as lint, complexity, duplication, dependency boundaries, dead code, static analysis dashboard, and mutation testing
Records hardening command slots such as SAST, dependency audit, secret scan, config validation, and resilience/failure tests
Keeps tools optional and stack-specific instead of mandating one universal linter stack
Does not install tools automatically unless code scaffold/tooling installation is explicitly in scope
Routes behavior-preserving cleanup to the refactoring skill and risk-reduction work to the hardening skill
